name: Kathoey
source:
Having been under pressure of a superstitious, conservative father and a critical community, May Kha always helped Mi Kha to cover her pain and tears with makeup. For a girl trapped in a male body, her elder sister May Kha has been her idol in her whole life. For Mi Kha, May Kha is not only a supportive sister, but also a second mother.

After her sex reassignment surgery (SRS), Mi Kha was invited to move in with her sister in the U.S. for about one year. May Kha is currently in a happy relationship with her soon-to-be-husband and is struggling with her life as a hard-working doctor. On the other hand, Mi Kha is stepping into her new life as a girl and is about to make moves on her new dream of being an actress. Will the two sisters reach their goals? Or will they miss the directions? It all depends on your choices.

translation:
在迷信保守的父親與苛刻的周遭環境壓迫下，梅・卡總會幫米・卡用妝容掩蓋痛苦與淚水。對這個困在男性身體裡的女孩來說，姊姊梅・卡一直是她一生的榜樣。梅・卡不僅是支持她的姊姊，也像第二位母親。

完成性別重置手術（SRS）後，米・卡受邀前往美國，與姊姊同住約一年。梅・卡與未婚夫感情幸福，身為認真的醫師，也正努力應對生活中的壓力。另一方面，米・卡即將以女性身分開啟全新人生，向成為演員的夢想邁進。兩姊妹能否實現各自的目標？還是會迷失方向？一切都取決於你的選擇。
